I have had a fantastic experience with Lebara. Their network reliability and value for money are great, but what truly sets them apart is their top-notch customer service.

reviews.title: Money for nothing
reviews.body: I have contracts running for phones not used. I constantly ask for help and you do not respond helpfully. I only have an email from previous complaint. My bank shows 2 x £5 payments one week then £5 and £9 next week. For 2 yrs my Granddaughter had no phone, text or data use leaving her unsafe after school. She can only use home WiFi. I am a foster carer and told the organisation lebara is unsafe to use for the children. I want refund of her contract and information why you are constantly charging me for many payments. I should have only 1 x £9 contract and 1 x£5 mine running. I am going to Ombudsman and review sites. I was going to upgrade my data but you are also more expensive than others for higher data. My Granddaughter is very upset. You also said youd cancel her contract as she had not used it!!! We wrote She Cannot as you wont allow it to be used. NO help as always
